map.比较法：评估值 = 案例价 × Π修正: Comparison approach: appraised value = comparable price × Π adjustment
map.💡 评估单价 = 案例单价 × 综合修正系数；修正额 = 案例单价 ×（系数 −: 💡 Appraised unit price = comparable unit price × combined adjustment factor; adjustment amount = comparable unit price × (factor − 1); a factor below 1 is a downward adjustment.
map.用可比案例价与修正系数快速得比准价。: Get an adjusted price quickly from a comparable price and an adjustment factor.
map.成本收益类输入时算总量与占比。: With cost or income inputs it returns the total and the share.
map.分级评分类输入时输出综合等级。: With graded scoring inputs it outputs an overall rating.
map.可比案例成交价 9000 元/㎡、综合修正系数 1.05 → 比准价=9000×: A comparable transaction price of 9000 yuan/sqm with a combined factor of 1.05 gives an adjusted price of 9000 × 1.05 = 9450 yuan/sqm (in cost/income mode this tool outputs total = A × B).
map.输入 A=单价 9000、B=面积 100㎡ → 总量=A×B=90 万元，差额: With A = unit price 9000 and B = area 100 sqm, total = A × B = 900,000 yuan, difference = A − B = 8900 and share = A ÷ B = 9000%; note this is a general two-input estimator.
map.这个工具和专门比较法工具有何区别？: How does this differ from a dedicated sales comparison tool?
map.本工具是通用双输入测算器，按标题自动在分级/比例/成本三种模式间切换；专业比较法: This is a general two-input estimator that switches between graded, ratio and cost modes by title; for professional comparison use the fuller-featured market comparison tool.
map.那是 A÷B 的数值占比显示，仅当 B 为比率/数量时有意义；价格÷面积场景应读: It is the numeric share A ÷ B, meaningful only where B is a rate or count; in a price ÷ area case read the total rather than the share.
map.比较法（可比案例/修正/计算）。免费在线工具，纯前端处理，数据不上传，保护隐私安: Sales Comparison (Comparables / Adjustment / Calculation). Free online tool, processed entirely in your browser; data is never uploaded, so your privacy stays protected.
map.市场比较法修正测算（生效版 calc 口径，页内后声明的真实业务版覆盖通用模板）: Market comparison adjustment (final calc on this page; the page's later version overrides the generic template): appraised unit price = case unit price×combined adjustment factor (yuan/m²); linked values at 100 m²: appraised total = unit price×100 (yuan), adjustment amount = case unit price×(factor−1) (yuan/m²). Validation: either value being non-numeric triggers the prompt to enter two valid numbers. Verdict: a factor <1 is a downward adjustment, >1 upward, =1 none, with the direction following the deviation from 1.
